meaning: Scientific base for MVP 3: the MVP 2 model with known category-A defects corrected. The only semantic difference from MVP 2 is B1.
previous_reference: baselines/mvp2/ (freeze commit f505fd118aa17bda3cc1cbb92afed13008bf102b; MVP 2 golden fixtures preserved in baselines/mvp2/golden/)

semantic_changes_from_mvp2.B1: On a merge (fusion, aggregation), familiarity is combined as both units' effective values at the merge year. MVP 2 decayed both maps to the source's last-iterated residence year (a loop variable shadowed the merge year). Code: population/composition.merge_state, population/lifecycle.merge_units. Because exponential decay composes and the population-weighted mean is linear in the excess over baseline, the systematic effect is small (rounding, the representation threshold and a stamp corner case); trajectories diverge stochastically.

git_commit: the commit that adds this manifest (git log baselines/mvp2_1/freeze_manifest.json)
belief_backend: sparse (production default; dense reference gives identical results)

validation.mechanism tests: tests/test_composition.py (merge decays to the merge year; residence cannot shadow it; weighting at a common time; row-level merge agrees)

pressure, 6 matched seeds x 400 y (farmi.mean energy deficit (farming vs foraging: 0.028 vs 0.043 -> 0.029 vs 0.038 (per seed: farming lower in 6/6 -> 4/6)

validation.statistical test change: the pressure test's energy-deficit check is pooled over its matched seeds (test_cultivated_populations_are_less_food_stressed_on_average); per-seed population, density and farm-share checks unchanged

defect_audit: objective/status.md Section 12.7: B1 the only category-A item; others are accepted limitations (B), deferred features (C) or documentation debt (D)
